name: DS Cluster S42: Calendar Shift (multi-asset alignment)
description: Tests: calendar_shift(period=91D) vs >> 63 positional lag. Calendar-aware lookback for quarterly returns.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S42: Calendar Shift
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === POSITIONAL LAG (bar-based) ===
close_63bars = close >> 63
bar_ret = (close - close_63bars) / close_63bars

# === CALENDAR SHIFT (calendar-day based) ===
close_91d = calendar_shift(period=91D)(close)
cal_ret = (close - close_91d) / close_91d

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Quarterly Returns: Bar-based (>>63) vs Calendar (91D)",
    category="Calendar Shift",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Bar-based", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Calendar", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(bar_ret, cal_ret))
